full: There's not much history to work from yet, so treat this as a starting point rather than a tailored call. Pick one easy thing today, a {duration}-min walk, jog, or ride, and log it. Fitness is built far more by showing up consistently than by any single session, and a few logged workouts in, these recommendations start adapting to you.
